Add the portrait photo here as: siyi-yu.jpg
The About Me page automatically uses it after reload in local development.
For deployment, run npm run build and publish the updated Site.
The photo address and both independent crops are configured in dist/profile.js.
portraitCrops.sleeve uses contain by default, preserving the whole portrait.
portraitCrops.disc uses a separate zoom / positionX / positionY to keep the face above the centre hole.
